verdict.rationale: Sentry's own AI integration has a documented switch that keeps AI prompt and response content out of captured spans while leaving other PII on. That is a real, if coarse, way to stop sensitive data reaching traces. It is all-or-nothing exclusion of AI content, not field-level masking or redaction. missing for 10: general-purpose trace/span scrubbing or masking (e.g., hooks to modify spans before sending), server-side data scrubbing rules, partial/pattern-based redaction of prompt content, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can mask or redact sensitive data before it is stored in traces

citations.quote: To keep other PII on but turn AI content off, set `include_prompts=False` on the integration.
